name: python-fibonacci-heap
title: Fibonacci Heap
blurb: A Fibonacci-ordered forest over integer-keyed items: the pop sequence equals sorted(corpus) on mixed push/pop/decrease storms, every degree stays under the log bound, and decrease-key never breaks heap order, checked by a shipped walk.
default_description: A Fibonacci-ordered forest over integer-keyed items whose pop sequence replays the plain sort and whose decrease-key keeps heap order.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff
